wallet.title: 1. Forge your Identity (Wallet)
wallet.description: Every adventure begins with a unique identity on the Stellar Blockchain. Create your wallet to securely hold your assets.
wallet.instructions: Cross the East Bridge (Blue) to the Armory and talk to Kael [NPC].

onramp.title: 2. Acquire Realm Coins (On-Ramp)
onramp.description: You need resources (XLM) to trade magical items. An anchor exchanges your real-world gold for network coins.
onramp.instructions: Enter the North Portal (Green) to the Exchange Port and talk to Captain HC [NPC].

soroban.title: 3. Trade on the Catalog (Smart Swap)
soroban.description: Use Soroban smart contracts to swap your XLM for USDC (Stable Gold) or SORO Battle Runes.
soroban.instructions: Enter the West Portal (Purple) to the Temple Market and talk to the Alchemist [NPC].

hold.title: 4. VIP Legend Holder Vault
hold.description: Show your long-term commitment by locking your coins in a smart vault to become a Legendary Guardian.
hold.instructions: Enter the South Portal (Golden) to the Secret Chamber and talk to Bobba [NPC], the Elder.

kill_center.title: Threat in the Central Square
kill_center.description: Invading Slimes are polluting the sacred Central Square! Prove your worth in combat by protecting the heart of the city.
kill_center.instructions: Activate Battle Mode (⚔️), eliminate 5 Slimes, and report your success to Master James.

kill_east.title: Warriors of the East Forge
kill_east.description: Cave Worms are attacking Blacksmith Kael's supplies! Prevent them from destroying the forge.
kill_east.instructions: Cross the East Portal (Blue), eliminate 5 Cave Worms, and return to Master James.

kill_north.title: Hunter of the North Docks
kill_north.description: Captain HC's sea routes have been blocked by Giant Crabs. Free the port!
kill_north.instructions: Cross the North Portal (Green), eliminate 5 Crabs, and return to Master James.

kill_west.title: Pathfinder of the West Bazaar
kill_west.description: Mutant bees are spreading panic in the alchemical market. Restore peace for the merchants!
kill_west.instructions: Cross the West Portal (Purple), eliminate 5 Bees, and return to Master James.

kill_south.title: Hero of the South Sanctuary
kill_south.description: Shadow snakes have corrupted the Sacred Sanctuary. This is your final trial as a Guardian!
kill_south.instructions: Cross the South Portal (Golden), eliminate 5 Snakes, and return to Master James.

all_done.title: THE END IS JUST THE BEGINNING
all_done.description: You have proven yourself to be the supreme hero of the Stellar network! But new grand quests are being forged by the gods.
all_done.instructions: Continue strengthening your heroes, collecting treasures, and preparing for the upcoming expansions!

I am James [NPC], the Temple Master. I am here to guide you through the Stellar network!
To begin your journey, you need to forge your Stellar Wallet with Kael [NPC].

q1_initial: Hello, young hero! Welcome to the main hall of the Stellar Temple!
I am James [NPC], the Temple Master. I am here to guide you through the Stellar network!
To begin your journey, you need to forge your Stellar Wallet with Kael [NPC].
The yellow magnetic arrow on your screen will guide your path. Head East (Cyan Portal) and forge your magic keys!
q1_active: Still don't have a wallet? Follow the magnetic arrow to the East Portal (Cyan) and speak with Blacksmith Kael [NPC]!
q1_done_q2_start: Sensational, hero! You have successfully forged your Stellar wallet! View your address on the top panel.
Now that you have a blockchain identity, you need your first XLM coins.
Your next quest is Quest 2: On-Ramp at the Exchange Port to the North with Captain HC [NPC].
I have unlocked the North Portal (Green) for you! Follow the magnetic arrow North and acquire your coins!
q2_active: Follow the magnetic arrow to the North Portal (Green) and speak with Captain HC [NPC] at the Exchange Terminal!
q2_done_q3_start: Excellent work! Your XLM coins were successfully credited by Captain HC's Anchor!
Now that you have balance, it's time to learn how to use Soroban Smart Contracts!
Your next quest is Quest 3: Soroban Bazaar at the West Portal (Purple) with the Alchemist [NPC].
I have unlocked the West Portal! Follow the magnetic arrow and perform a Swap for USDC stable dollars or SORO tokens!
q3_active: Follow the magnetic arrow to the West Portal (Purple) and speak with the Alchemist [NPC] at the swap terminal!
q3_done_q4_start: Magnificent! You executed a Soroban smart contract in seconds with negligible fees!
You learned how to create a wallet, fund it, and trade assets. Only the final Holder test remains!
Your final quest is Quest 4: VIP Vault at the South Portal (Golden) with Elder Bobba [NPC].

all_completed: 🌟 GLORY AND HONOR! You completed all onboarding quests of the Stellar Temple!
You are officially a Stellar Holder Legendary Guardian! Your title shines across the realm.
Feel free to explore the island and interact with other hero players in online multiplayer!
active: Follow the magnetic arrow to the active quest portal!
completed: Sensational! You have registered your Stellar wallet. View your secure address on the top HUD bar!

main: Battle greetings! I am Kael [NPC], the greatest blacksmith of Magic Plate Armors and Rare Helms in this temple.
On Stellar, you don't log in with traditional email and password. You create your account through Asymmetric Hero Cryptography!
The Public Key (starts with 'G') is your address or Temple ID. Everyone on the continent can see it to send you coins.
The Secret Key (starts with 'S') is the key to your personal treasure chest. If any orc gets it, they'll take all your rares! Never reveal it to anyone!
Approach the Key Altar right behind me to forge your account!
active: Use the blue cybernetic key terminal to generate your key pair and receive your host address!
completed: Your account was successfully created and registered on the Stellar network Ledger!
Now that you have an identity, you are ready to get catalog coins. Head North and speak with Captain HC [NPC]!

main: Ahoy, adventurer! I am Captain HC [NPC], in charge of the naval routes and financial bridges of the continent.
On the Stellar network, we call deposit and withdrawal ramps 'Anchors'. They convert fictional gold into real digital coins (XLM).
Without an anchor, real-world coins couldn't enter the blockchain!
Approach the Exchange Altar next to me to make a simulated gold deposit and earn your first Crystal Coins!
active: Access the Exchange Terminal next to me to deposit via fictional PIX or Card and load your balance!
completed: Elite transaction, adventurer! The anchor identified your deposit and sent 150 XLM of balance to you.
Your updated balance already shines in the top right! Now you can trade assets in the catalog.
Head East to the Soroban Market to trade via Smart Contracts!

main: Welcome to the Temple's Trading Hub!
Soroban is Stellar's ultra-efficient smart contract engine.
With them, we program unbreakable financial rules. We can swap coins instantly without middlemen or banks!
To prove your skills, approach the purple alchemical panel next to me.
Trigger the smart contract to swap 50 XLM for USDC (Digital Dollar) or SORO governance tokens!
active: Approach the purple Soroban terminal and execute the automatic swap via Smart Contract!
completed: Magnificent! The trade was settled in under 2 seconds with fees of a fraction of a cent!
Your inventory now has USDC and SORO tokens. You are a master of catalog trading!
The final test awaits you in the South. Go to the Hold Chamber and speak with Bobba [NPC], the Elder!

main: Bobba bobba bobba! What a fantastic journey, young warrior!
You forged keys, acquired coins with the Anchor, and traded rares using Soroban smart contracts.
The final test is the ultimate virtue: patience and loyalty, that is, to 'Hold'.
Locking your coins in a decentralized Escrow contract proves that you are a faithful holder to the ecosystem.
Approach the Golden Hold Chamber ahead to lock a percentage of XLM and earn the title of Legendary Guardian!
active: Interact with the golden Sacred Chamber to seal your long-term hold and earn the definitive insignia!
completed: 🌟 The temple celebrates in joy! You have completed all modules of the Onboarding Archipelago!
Your coins are safely locked in the vault. You are officially a Legendary Stellar Holder Guardian!
Remember: fast transactions, tiny fees, and truly accessible finance. Now relax in the tavern with some mead! Bobba!

login.title: Welcome to Stellar Island
login.subtitle: An interactive Web3 RPG adventure to learn about the Stellar ecosystem, wallets, and smart contracts.
login.securityDesc: Use Passkeys for passwordless Web3 login
login.fastDesc: Transactions confirm in seconds on Stellar
login.frictionlessDesc: Enter instantly without filling out complicated forms. You can forge your wallet with cryptographic security when exploring the island.
login.nameHint: Leave blank or enter any nickname to enter 100% free.
login.howItWorksDesc1: Progress and stats data are kept in your browser. After creating the wallet in the East Region, the game integrates with local
login.howItWorksDesc3: authentication, allowing you to login with a single tap without needing conventional passwords.
login.confirmResetDesc: This will remove all current progress, transaction history, and the cryptographic wallet generated in your browser. Great for testing onboarding from scratch!
login.deviceAuthDesc: Please scan your fingerprint or use registered facial authentication to verify your stellar wallet.

huds.secret_key: ⚠ SECRET KEY (Admin Password - Keep it safe!)
huds.no_identity_desc: Talk to Kael [NPC] at the Stellar Temple to create your wallet.
huds.ledger_sequencer_desc: Stellar operates in fast consensus batches every 5 seconds. No mining energy or heavy fees are wasted.
huds.awaiting_transactions: Waiting for transactions on the network...
huds.interact_altars: Interact with the temple altars to emit live transactions!
huds.survival_desc: Welcome to the educational temple! The goal of this RPG is to guide you through practical Web3 concepts using the Stellar network in a fully understandable way.
huds.guide_a1: In Web3, you don't create logins with a conventional email and password. Instead, your address is a Public Key (which everyone can see, like a PIX) mathematically generated from a Secret Key (your private password, kept in a vault). If you lose the secret, you lose everything!
huds.guide_a2: One of Stellar's greatest innovations is Anchors. They work as licensed digital exchange houses integrated into the blockchain, allowing you to send local fiat currencies (like Reais or Dollars) and transform them into stable virtual assets (like USDC) instantly.
huds.guide_a3: Soroban is Stellar's smart contract engine that executes secure Rust code directly on consensus. With them, we can program automatic transactions without intermediaries, such as making Swaps (coin exchanges) in decentralized liquidity pools immediately.
huds.guide_q4: 4. What does it mean to Hold / Escrow?
huds.guide_a4: To "Hold" means to lock financial assets in an automated vault without third-party custody for a predetermined period. This ensures loyalty to the ecosystem, allowing you to earn rewards and consolidate your presence as a holder in the global ecosystem.
huds.guide_footer: Stellar Temple • All data simulated locally for warrior training purposes.

guide.name: James
dialogs: Welcome to the main hall of the Stellar Temple, young traveler! This is where Web3 magic comes to life.
I am James, the Temple Master, and I will be your guide through this island of decentralized innovations.
Our island is an educational archipelago designed to teach you everything about decentralized finance (DeFi) through 4 crucial quests.
First, you will need a secure digital identity. Cross the blue bridge to the East to the Cave and forge your Wallet with the Key Master.
With your wallet ready, the second quest will take you to the North Port, where you will learn to use 'On-Ramp' to turn local currency into digital assets.
Next, in the third quest, the West plaza will reveal the secrets of Smart Contracts, where you'll make lightning-fast token swaps.
And finally, the fourth quest in the South Sanctuary will test your loyalty by teaching the power of long-term 'Holding'.
Complete all quests to earn the title of Legendary Guardian! Shall we begin? Head East first and create your wallet!
activeQuestDialogs: You still lack an account! Head East and speak with Kael [NPC] to forge your keypair.
completedDialogs: Excellent! I see you have successfully forged your Stellar wallet.
Now you need coins to trade. The North corridor has been unlocked!
Cross the North Portal and speak with Captain HC [NPC] to acquire your first XLM.

keymaster.name: Kael [NPC]
dialogs: Greetings! I am Kael [NPC], the forger of rare relics in this temple.
Here, you don't use emails or passwords. You create an identity using cryptography!
Your Public Key (starts with 'G') is your public address. Anyone can see it and send you coins.
The Secret Key (starts with 'S') is your vault's master key. Never reveal it, or you'll lose everything!
Access the Key Altar behind me to forge your account now.
activeQuestDialogs: Use the blue terminal to generate your keypair and receive your network address!
completedDialogs: There you go! Your account has been flawlessly forged on the Stellar network.
Return to the Main Lobby and seek your next destination to the North!

portmaster.name: Captain HC [NPC]
dialogs: Ahoy, adventurer! I am Captain HC [NPC], in charge of the financial port.
On Stellar, we use Anchors to bridge real-world money into digital assets.
Without an Anchor, real-world currencies could never enter the blockchain!
Access the Exchange Terminal beside me to make a simulated deposit and receive Crystal Coins (XLM)!
activeQuestDialogs: Interact with the Exchange Terminal to deposit and charge your wallet with XLM!
completedDialogs: Transaction complete! The Anchor has dispatched 150 shiny XLM to your wallet.
Now you have funds to trade. Head West and seek out the Alchemist!

scholar.name: Alchemist [NPC]
dialogs: Greetings, hero! Welcome to the arcane market of Soroban.
Soroban is Stellar's smart contract system. It is blazing fast, cheap, and secure.
With smart contracts, we can perform instant swaps without relying on a bank.
Interact with the purple alchemical panel to execute a contract and swap some XLM for USDC and SORO tokens!
activeQuestDialogs: Access the purple terminal to test the power of a Soroban smart contract!
completedDialogs: Magical! The swap was settled in a few seconds and for a fraction of a cent.
Your inventory now holds USDC and SORO. You have mastered catalog trading!
Only one challenge remains. Head South and find Elder Bobba.

sage.name: Elder Bobba [NPC]
dialogs: Bobba bobba bobba! What a magnificent journey, young warrior!
You forged your keys, on-ramped funds, and wielded the magic of smart contracts.
The final virtue of a Stellar adventurer is long-term loyalty, the sacred 'Hold'.
Approach the Golden Hold Chamber. Lock a portion of your treasures to claim the ultimate title of Legendary Guardian!
activeQuestDialogs: Interact with the golden chamber to lock your funds in an Escrow contract!
completedDialogs: 🌟 The temple exalts your name! You have completed the entire Onboarding Archipelago journey!
Your treasures are securely locked. You are now officially a Legendary Stellar Holder Guardian!
Enjoy blazing fast, decentralized finance. Bobba!

gamefinow_info.name: GAMEFINOW INFO
dialogs: Gamefinow Info Terminal.
Gamefinow is the premier ecosystem bridging decentralized finance (DeFi) with interactive fun (GameFi) on the Stellar network.
Here in the Temple, you will learn the basics of Web3: forging wallets, using on-ramp, executing swaps, and understanding the power of holding.
Interact with the quests to unlock the paths and earn your Legendary NFT!

walletnow_info.name: WALLETNOW INFO
dialogs: Walletnow Info Terminal.
Walletnow is your ultimate analytics and tracking dashboard for the DeFi ecosystem.
Their technology ensures you have a secure portal to Web3, tracking your yields and NFTs optimally.
Find the official Walletnow terminal in the Eastern cave to create your own wallet.

nearx_info.name: NEARX INFO
dialogs: Nearx Info Terminal.
Nearx is the leading On-Ramp and Off-Ramp infrastructure on the Stellar blockchain.
It acts as a reliable bridge so you can buy digital assets using your local currency 100% securely and regulated.
The main Nearx port can be found on the beach North of the central map.

defindex_info.name: DEFINDEX INFO
dialogs: Defindex Info Terminal.
Defindex pioneers in building tools to automate and optimize yields in a decentralized way.
Focusing on the Soroban ecosystem, they develop smart vaults and indexes to facilitate your DeFi investments.
Find the Defindex contract simulators integrated with Soroswap in the Western square.

soroswap_info.name: SOROSWAP INFO
dialogs: Soroswap Info Terminal.
Soroswap is the leading decentralized exchange (DEX) and automated market maker (AMM) in the Soroban ecosystem.
The platform allows any user to swap Stellar network tokens incredibly fast with near-zero fees.
You can test the powerful Swap settlements at the terminal located on the West side.

pigfi_info.name: PIGFI INFO
dialogs: Small amounts, a universe of possibilities.
The childhood piggy bank has evolved. With PigFi, your family can start saving dollars starting from R$50 via Pix in a simple, visual, and fun way.

wave_info.name: WAVE INFO
dialogs: Condominium administration and governance with transparency and security.
Streamlining property management, financial tracking, and community decision-making on the Stellar blockchain.

hero.subtitle: ✦ Learn. Play. Grow. ✦
hero.description: The first MMO where every action is a real on-chain transaction. Real wallets, real tokens, real DeFi — disguised as fun.

startup.title: About the Startup (Pitch Deck)
startup.subtitle: Gamifying crypto and DeFi adoption on the Stellar blockchain for the next generation of users.
startup.problem_desc: Onboarding into Web3 and DeFi remains complex, scary, and full of friction for 99% of mainstream users. GameFiNow solves this by transforming real financial primitives (wallets, swaps, yield vaults, local fiat payments) into an immersive 2D retro MMO game. Every interaction in the game is a transparent transaction on Stellar, making financial education and DeFi usage natural, visual, and fun.
startup.product_desc:
A multiplayer 2D RPG universe powered by Stellar and Soroban smart contracts. Our product offers:

• 1-click non-custodial onboarding via WalletNow.
• Integrated Fiat On-Ramp for stablecoins (USDW/BRW).
• On-chain P2P marketplace for items and cosmetics (NFTs).
• Deflationary Yield Vaults with a Staking system.
• A gamified hub connecting over 12 protocols from the Stellar ecosystem.
startup.market_desc:
We operate at the perfect convergence between the Web3 Gaming ($30B+) and Decentralized Finance ($100B+ TVL) markets. Our core target audience includes:

• Casual and nostalgic gamers seeking retro aesthetics (Tibia/Pokemon style).
• Crypto enthusiasts in Latin America and emerging markets looking for fast, low-cost payments.
• DeFi newcomers who want passive income and self-custody without traditional entry barriers and complex jargon.
startup.business_desc:
Our monetization is sustainable, deflationary, and directly linked to protocol usage:

• 0.5% fee applied to all P2P trades and DEX Swaps (shared between the Treasury and GAMEFI token burning).
• Sale of Premium Outfits and exclusive Skins (limited edition NFTs).
• Performance/management fee applied to Yield Vaults via Soroban.
• B2B (Business to Business) integration packages and custom booths on the map for other ecosystem partners.
startup.future_desc:
Our roadmap to scale globally and become the largest gamified DeFi integration hub:

• Official launch on Stellar Mainnet and listings on major DEXs/CEXs.
• Development and integration of a native Mobile app (iOS/Android) with Passkeys.
• Decentralized Governance System (DAO) implemented in the North District.
• Organization of Battle Tournaments with massive Prize Pools in stablecoins.
• Smart Cross-Chain expansion and support for new automated liquidity pools based on Soroban's evolution.

what.title: What is GameFiNow?
what.subtitle: A revolution at the intersection of gaming and decentralized finance — built on Stellar.
what.vision_text: GameFiNow is a massively multiplayer online game where the entire economy lives on the Stellar blockchain. Every player action — creating a wallet, swapping tokens, trading items — is a real on-chain transaction.
what.stellar_text: Stellar provides 5-second finality, fees of 0.00001 XLM per transaction, and native multi-asset support. With Soroban smart contracts, GameFiNow offers programmable DeFi primitives directly inside the game world.
what.defi_text: Quest 1 = wallet creation. Quest 2 = on-ramp. Quest 3 = token swaps. Quest 4 = yield vaults. By finishing onboarding, players are real DeFi users — without knowing it was that complex.
what.ecosystem_text: GameFiNow is a platform for the Stellar DeFi ecosystem. 12 partner protocols — Soroswap, WalletNow, DefIndex, PigFi, Dupply, NIDO, AutoFin, NEARX, WAVE, TroqPay, Vellora, and MUTAV — have dedicated stands inside the world.

howtoplay.title: How to Play
howtoplay.subtitle: Complete interactive onboarding guide, RPG combat mechanics, and mastering the on-chain economy.
howtoplay.step1_desc: The first step is to create your own Stellar wallet without needing to store complex passwords, using secure Passkeys on your device (like fingerprint or FaceID). Integration with the WalletNow SDK allows you to create the wallet in 1 click. Immediately after creation, the protocol will fund your account with Testnet resources so you don't get stuck.
howtoplay.step2_desc: Once you are familiar with your wallet (main inventory), you will need real funds or stablecoins. Use the deposit portal (On-Ramp) via local payment methods to convert your local currency directly into stablecoins (like BRW or USDW). Everything is processed and settled in just 5 seconds, providing the necessary balance for transactions and minimal fees.
howtoplay.step3_desc: Explore vast and rich biomes: Deep Caves, Tropical Beaches, Elemental Gardens, and Ancient Sanctuaries. Face classic creatures (Slimes, Cave Worms, Crabs, Bees, and Snakes) ranging from Level 1 to 10 in real-time combat. Use hotkey mechanics to cast active spells (Heal, Fire, Lightning) that consume Mana (MP). Defeat monsters, collect experience (XP), and level up your hero to the coveted level 99. Note: XP gain scales mathematically! Fighting monsters above your level yields massive XP bonuses, while hunting weak monsters severely reduces your gains.
howtoplay.step4_desc: Defeated monsters will drop precious GAMEFI tokens and valuable Gems. These items go straight to your inventory (stackable up to 99). With your drops secured on the blockchain, you can head to the P2P Shop in the Central Square. There you freely trade any resource, deciding the price, paying only a small 0.5% network fee to the treasury.
howtoplay.step5_desc: As an ecosystem investor, the pinnacle of the journey is making your funds work for you. Lock your GAMEFI tokens in Yield Vaults secured by unbreakable Soroban contracts. In exchange for the liquidity provided, you earn passive APY, accumulate Legendary Glory Points, and receive potent permanent Buffs (Strength/Intelligence) for your character, making you invincible in upcoming explorations.

tokenomics.title: Tokenomics
tokenomics.subtitle: Multi-asset economy powered by real Stellar on-chain assets.

onchain.title: On-Chain Data
onchain.subtitle: All contracts and addresses are public. Verify everything directly on Stellar.

economy.title: Economy
economy.subtitle: A fully functional DeFi economy running inside the game world.
economy.p2p_text: List and trade in-game items for GAMEFI. Every trade settles on-chain with 0.5% fee to the treasury. Full provenance for all items.
economy.faucet_text: Free XLM from Stellar Friendbot for new players. 24h cooldown — gamified as a real fountain in the game world.
economy.vault_text: Lock 100+ GAMEFI for 24h. Soroban-enforced. Earn yield, unlock cosmetics, gain governance power.
economy.dex_text: SoroSwap integration. Trade USDW ↔ GAMEFI ↔ XLM in-game. Same Soroban contract used on production.
economy.guild_text: Create or join a Guild for 50 GAMEFI. Each guild has a custom tag (e.g. [STAR]), icon, banner color, shared treasury, and member roles (Leader, Officer, Member). Guild leaders can teleport directly to the Guildhouse on the map.
economy.class_text: At the Sacred Fountain (unlocked after Quest 1), consecrate your hero as one of 4 classes: Stellar Warrior ⚔️, Soroban Alchemist 🧙, Cosmic Hunter 🏹, or Network Guardian 🛡️. Each class has unique stat multipliers and a passive skill. Changing class costs 10 GAMEFI.

world.title: World Map
world.subtitle: 5 interconnected districts — each with unique experiences, partners and DeFi mechanics.
world.center_desc: The beating heart of GameFiNow. This is where every journey begins. The Central Plaza hosts the on-chain ATM DeFi terminal, the P2P trading store, the cosmetics shop with exclusive outfits, the Faucet fountain for free XLM, and all partner stands from Soroswap, WalletNow, DefIndex, PigFi, Dupply, NIDO, AutoFin, NEARX, WAVE, TroqPay, Vellora and MUTAV. 12 active protocols, 5 NPCs, and countless on-chain interactions — all in one place.
world.east_desc: Accessible via the East Portal in the Central Plaza, the East District is the advanced zone for experienced DeFi players. Here you'll find deeper liquidity mechanics, yield vault access and future Soroban-native quests designed for users who already know their way around Web3.
world.west_desc: The social hub of the GameFiNow universe. The West District connects players through community-driven events, guild mechanics and competitive gameplay. Accessible via the West Portal and designed for players who want more than just DeFi — they want community.
world.north_desc: Reserved for the future DAO governance layer of GameFiNow. As the protocol matures, token holders will access the North District to vote on key decisions: fee adjustments, new partner onboarding, token emission rules, and world expansions.
world.south_desc: A collector's paradise and seasonal hub. The South District is designed for players who love rare items, limited drops, and exclusive cosmetic quests. Future home of the mobile companion app gateway and seasonal in-game events with on-chain rewards.

level5_intro.desc1: You have proven your worth to the island and unlocked the entire GameFi ecosystem. The real game begins now!
level5_intro.desc2: To fight, click on the enemy, wait for the target to lock, and approach! You won't lose coins when you die, and defeating enemies grants GAMEFI tokens. Check the swords icon on the right HUD.
level5_intro.desc3: Buy a Pickaxe at the P2P Shop in the East map! With it, approach precious stones in the South map to mine gems and potentially GAMEFI tokens.
level5_intro.atm_desc: The DeFi ATM will concentrate all your deposit, swap, and on-ramp operations in one place.
level5_intro.desc5: The entire island is now under your domain. Explore, mine, fight, and invest.

welcome_tutorial.title: Welcome to
welcome_tutorial.desc1: You have just arrived on the island. Prepare yourself for an amazing adventure integrating Web3 and GameFi.
welcome_tutorial.desc2: Use the W, A, S, D keys or the Arrow Keys on your keyboard to move around the island.
welcome_tutorial.desc3: Go to the center of the island and talk to James immediately. He will give you vital instructions to create your Web3 wallet and start your journey.
welcome_tutorial.hint_desc: To interact with NPCs or objects, simply walk up to them!
